entries.title: Psalms 78:1
segments: ¶<<A Contemplation of Asaph.>> Give ear, O my people, [to] my law; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 78:2
segments: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,

entries.title: Psalms 78:3
segments: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

entries.title: Psalms 78:4
segments: We will not hide [them] from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength and His wonderful works that He has done.

entries.title: Psalms 78:5
segments: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

entries.title: Psalms 78:6
segments: That the generation to come might know [them], The children [who] would be born, [That] they may arise and declare [them] to their children,

entries.title: Psalms 78:7
segments: That they may set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;

entries.title: Psalms 78:8
segments: And may not be like their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation [that] did not set its heart aright, And whose spirit was not faithful to God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:9
segments: ¶The children of Ephraim, [being] armed [and] carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 78:10
segments: They did not keep the covenant of God; They refused to walk in His law,

entries.title: Psalms 78:11
segments: And forgot His works And His wonders that He had shown them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:12
segments: Marvelous things He did in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:13
segments: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters stand up like a heap.

entries.title: Psalms 78:14
segments: In the daytime also He led them with the cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:15
segments: He split the rocks in the wilderness, And gave [them] drink in abundance like the depths.

entries.title: Psalms 78:16
segments: He also brought streams out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 78:17
segments: But they sinned even more against Him By rebelling against the Most High in the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 78:18
segments: And they tested God in their heart By asking for the food of their fancy.

entries.title: Psalms 78:19
segments: Yes, they spoke against God: They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

entries.title: Psalms 78:20
segments: Behold, He struck the rock, So that the waters gushed out, And the streams overflowed. Can He give bread also? Can He provide meat for His people?"

entries.title: Psalms 78:21
segments: Therefore the LORD heard [this] and was furious; So a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also came up against Israel,

entries.title: Psalms 78:22
segments: Because they did not believe in God, And did not trust in His salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:23
segments: Yet He had commanded the clouds above, And opened the doors of heaven,

entries.title: Psalms 78:24
segments: Had rained down manna on them to eat, And given them of the bread of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 78:25
segments: Men ate angels' food; He sent them food to the full.

entries.title: Psalms 78:26
segments: He caused an east wind to blow in the heavens; And by His power He brought in the south wind.

entries.title: Psalms 78:27
segments: He also rained meat on them like the dust, Feathered fowl like the sand of the seas;

entries.title: Psalms 78:28
segments: And He let [them] fall in the midst of their camp, All around their dwellings.

entries.title: Psalms 78:29
segments: So they ate and were well filled, For He gave them their own desire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:30
segments: They were not deprived of their craving; But while their food [was] still in their mouths,

entries.title: Psalms 78:31
segments: The wrath of God came against them, And slew the stoutest of them, And struck down the choice [men] of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:32
segments: In spite of this they still sinned, And did not believe in His wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 78:33
segments: Therefore their days He consumed in futility, And their years in fear.

entries.title: Psalms 78:34
segments: When He slew them, then they sought Him; And they returned and sought earnestly for God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:35
segments: Then they remembered that God [was] their rock, And the Most High God their Redeemer.

entries.title: Psalms 78:36
segments: Nevertheless they flattered Him with their mouth, And they lied to Him with their tongue;

entries.title: Psalms 78:37
segments: For their heart was not steadfast with Him, Nor were they faithful in His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 78:38
segments: But He, [being] full of compassion, forgave [their] iniquity, And did not destroy [them]. Yes, many a time He turned His anger away, And did not stir up all His wrath;

entries.title: Psalms 78:39
segments: For He remembered that they [were but] flesh, A breath that passes away and does not come again.

entries.title: Psalms 78:40
segments: ¶How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, [And] grieved Him in the desert!

entries.title: Psalms 78:41
segments: Yes, again and again they tempted God, And limited the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:42
segments: They did not remember His power: The day when He redeemed them from the enemy,

entries.title: Psalms 78:43
segments: When He worked His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan;

entries.title: Psalms 78:44
segments: Turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, that they could not drink.

entries.title: Psalms 78:45
segments: He sent swarms of flies among them, which devoured them, And frogs, which destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:46
segments: He also gave their crops to the caterpillar, And their labor to the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:47
segments: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore trees with frost.

entries.title: Psalms 78:48
segments: He also gave up their cattle to the hail, And their flocks to fiery lightning.

entries.title: Psalms 78:49
segments: He cast on them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, indignation, and trouble, By sending angels of destruction [among them].

entries.title: Psalms 78:50
segments: He made a path for His anger; He did not spare their soul from death, But gave their life over to the plague,

entries.title: Psalms 78:51
segments: And destroyed all the firstborn in Egypt, The first of [their] strength in the tents of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 78:52
segments: But He made His own people go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock;

entries.title: Psalms 78:53
segments: And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 78:54
segments: And He brought them to His holy border, This mountain [which] His right hand had acquired.

entries.title: Psalms 78:55
segments: He also drove out the nations before them, Allotted them an inheritance by survey, And made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:56
segments: Yet they tested and provoked the Most High God, And did not keep His testimonies,

entries.title: Psalms 78:57
segments: But turned back and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

entries.title: Psalms 78:58
segments: For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.

entries.title: Psalms 78:59
segments: When God heard [this], He was furious, And greatly abhorred Israel,

entries.title: Psalms 78:60
segments: So that He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent He had placed among men,

entries.title: Psalms 78:61
segments: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the enemy's hand.

entries.title: Psalms 78:62
segments: He also gave His people over to the sword, And was furious with His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:63
segments: The fire consumed their young men, And their maidens were not given in marriage.

entries.title: Psalms 78:64
segments: Their priests fell by the sword, And their widows made no lamentation.

entries.title: Psalms 78:65
segments: Then the Lord awoke as [from] sleep, Like a mighty man who shouts because of wine.

entries.title: Psalms 78:66
segments: And He beat back His enemies; He put them to a perpetual reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 78:67
segments: Moreover He rejected the tent of Joseph, And did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,

entries.title: Psalms 78:68
segments: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which He loved.

entries.title: Psalms 78:69
segments: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He has established forever.

entries.title: Psalms 78:70
segments: He also chose David His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;

entries.title: Psalms 78:71
segments: From following the ewes that had young He brought him, To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:72
segments: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
